trust_decision.summary: Values stored in the DB by unauthenticated ingestion routes (POST /api/v1/output, POST /api/v1/batch: batch label, configuration, input path, job_options, output/commit dirs, user, hexsha, batch commands) and request fields of the tuning/group routes are trusted when the backend builds bash scripts, bash -c strings and shell=True LSF-bridge commands; the fix quotes every value at the sink (shlex.quote), refuses non-shell-safe values in the bridge template, takes the user from the login session and requires login on the action routes.

landing_point.why: Summary says 'output redo/tuning'; the redo route calls Output.redo, which builds redo.sh with single/double-quote interpolation and runs it through the LSF bridge with shell=True.

fix_sites.module_kind: model -> qaboard CLI runner library (JobGroup.stop -> bkill via bridge)

fix_sites.entry_point: POST /api/v1/commit/save-artifacts (also reached from both redo paths)
fix_sites.module_kind: model (git argv, option injection via hexsha)

fix_sites.entry_point: new backend/backend/shell_utils.py helper used by all of the above
login_required decorator applied to ~17 action routes

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: backend/backend/models/Batch.py:133-146 (stop: unauthenticated batch.data['commands'] spread into JobGroup job_options, formatted into the LSF bridge by qaboard/runners/lsf.py:316-319 with shell=True at qaboard/runners/lsf.py:321-326); also backend/backend/models/CiCommit.py:173 (git worktree add <hexsha>, argv option injection, not a shell)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Batch.stop is a 'stop/kill' feature, not redo/tuning, and its sink lives in the qaboard CLI runner package; CiCommit.save_artifacts uses an argv list (no shell), so it looks safe to a solver searching for shell=True.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Redo/tuning must still run commands whose legitimate values contain spaces, quotes, JSON (--tuning '{...}'), '=' and paths; the bridge template must still substitute {user}/{bsub_command}; the env exports and .envrc sourcing must keep working. Blanket rejection of non-alphanumeric labels/configurations or of JSON tuning parameters breaks redo; quoting {bsub_command} once breaks the documented ssh 'bsub_su {user} -I {bsub_command}' template.

O6_input_shapes: value breaking out of single quotes (configuration, database, type, tuning JSON, job_options queue/resources/max_memory/max_threads, platform, batch_label, selected_group)
value breaking out of double quotes ($(), backticks) (batch label, input path, artifacts dir, script path)
unquoted positional value (tests/group name, merged batches path, command_id)
value starting with '-' parsed as an option (input path after '--', group name after '--', hexsha to git worktree)
value in a template re-parsed by a second shell (LSF bridge {user}/{bsub_command}; bsub job command parsed again on the exec host)
non-string JSON types (str() before quote for platform, batch_label, job_id, max_memory)
path traversal in group file name / project id (get_groups_path)

O7_producer.where: backend/backend/api/outputs.py:175-192 (output.data incl. job_options, user, output_dir_override, commit_dir_override) and backend/backend/api/batch.py:29,55-61 (batch_dir_override, batch.data, batch.data['commands']); both remain unauthenticated after the fix

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Output.redo quotes job_options queue/resources into `qa batch --lsf-queue/--lsf-resources`, but the qa CLI's LSF runner re-interpolates them into `-q '{queue}'` / `-R "{resources}"` and runs bsub with shell=True (second shell parse in the CLI layer); options['options'] is also passed raw.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The CLI runner treats its flags as local, trusted user input; the backend already quoted them so 'it's fixed at the source'.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different top-level package (qaboard/ CLI vs backend/), reached via qaboard/qa.py:535-640 and qaboard/runners/lsf.py:179-188

O8_uncovered_routes.route: PUT /api/v1/output/<id> lets an unauthenticated caller rewrite output.data (job_options, user) that Output.redo later consumes; the fix quotes at the sink but leaves this producer unauthenticated.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Metadata update route used by the CLI; the sink-side quoting is the advertised protection.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as the redo handler

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Redo and tests/group `source` .envrc files from the artifacts dir and its parents, where the artifacts dir comes from commit_dir_override set by unauthenticated POST /api/v1/output; quoting the path does not stop executing an attacker-chosen .envrc.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Sourcing .envrc is a documented feature and needs a file on the shared filesystem.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: another runner branch (e.g. dask/celery job_options -> --dask-* flags) built with f"'{...}'" interpolation
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The code has a TODO to 'support other runners'; a maintainer would copy the LSF branch.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: save-artifacts with a user-supplied branch/ref passed to git or a qa subcommand via a shell string
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Neighbouring route already passes request.json['hexsha'] into git; a ref option is a natural feature.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: stop_jobs formats the bridge with **job_options, so any added key (user, queue) flows into a shell string
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The format(**job_options) idiom already exists; the fix filters only at the backend caller.
